title: Playboy Magazine December 2008 Carol Alt Hugh Jackman Interview Katy Perry Xmas
conditionDescription: Cover shows light wear. Centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Playboy Magazine, December 2008 Gala Christmas Issue. Cover price $6.99.

Features:
- Carol Alt - A Tropical Holiday Treat
- Playboy Interview with Hugh Jackman
- Annual Music Poll starring Katy Perry
- Rosario Dawson 20Q
- Denis Leary - Why We Suck, an exclusive excerpt
- James Ellroy - first look at Blood's a Rover
- A letter to the new President by Gary Hart
- Jodi Picoult, Walter Mosley, Margaret Atwood and Jonathan Lethem on their favorite comics

Carol Alt cover. The back cover carries an Absolut vodka ad.

Condition: pre-owned with normal signs of age and storage. Cover shows light wear. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
